title: rata-tools: Role-Aware Transportability Audit primitives
description: rata-tools 0.2.0 provides reusable Python primitives for auditing the transportability of transcriptomic signatures. It implements evidence-capacity metrics, selection-aware cross-validation, matched selection-null decisions, binary and cohort-stratified survival transport gates, Harrell C-index utilities, and structured three-gate decisions. The release includes a Python API, command-line interface, tests, examples, documentation and continuous-integration configuration.
